claim_ceiling: MIXED at bounded synthetic single-family Flask catalog mock (L=10 fixed, token/browser proxy 500 tok/novel step, 12 stores, 5 A demos, harness-level distill_parameterized via SpiderKernel.resolve/MechanismRegistry but with hardcoded freshness/confidence UNKNOWN gating) remains descriptive; C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY remains HYPOTHESIS. No evidence for WebArena-Verified DOM, cross-site transfer, or real LLM economics. Demonstrated: SPIDER resolve/bind pipeline executes without crash, freshness/confidence gating exercised (UNKNOWN at n>=0.75), B-LENGTH falsifier reachable (rho 0), C2 SPIDER/COLD 0.25 pass and C4 R2 delta 0.927 pass. Not demonstrated: novelty-proportional cost beyond deterministic gating (variance 0 at 4/5 bins), beating retrievable RAG or 0-token REPLAY inside compared set (hit 0.05 not 1.0), or non-flat NC controls; p=0.017 fails frozen <0.01, and SPIDER/COLD 1.116 exceeds 1.10 at 100%. Do not promote to Product Core or to C-PRODUCT-ECON scale-up; Intel sample-level overlap and Runtime distributed replication remain prerequisites for Docker/real-LLM test.
